Skills profiles in the HR system
A profile can list skills that an employee claimed or that the system inferred. The profile does not show whether anyone tested the skill or when.

Course completions
A learning record shows when an employee finished a course. Completion does not show whether the employee can apply the skill to a realistic task today.
reviews
Manager ratings

Your leaders then make staffing decisions from skills data that may be untested or out of date.
An employee skill tracking platform for knowledge workers
Codility Skills Intelligence is an employee skill tracking platform for the knowledge workers you already employ.
Skills Intelligence has two sections on one assessment engine.
work
AI for Business covers business functions through work simulations.
code
The Tech section covers engineers through coding tasks.
Both sections use deterministic scoring, so the same output always receives the same score.
Record scored results for employees across business functions
A self-rating records how confident an employee feels about a skill.
In an AI for Business work simulation, an employee responds to a realistic brief using the AI Assistant.
Codility scores the submitted output against an expert-defined answer space for that task.
Each completed work simulation adds a scored result and its assessment date to the employee’s record.
You can track employees in business functions including sales, marketing, customer support, customer success, finance and data analysis.
Your leaders can use tested, dated results when making staffing decisions for business teams.

Track engineers’ proficiency over time in the Tech section
The Tech section tracks engineering skills on the same platform as business-role results.
Engineers complete coding tasks in a realistic development environment.
Passed test cases and task difficulty determine a proficiency level for each assessed skill. Skills Intelligence uses a five-level scale from novice to expert.
The level updates to include the result of each new assessment.
Each engineer’s profile lists the date each skill was last assessed.
The profile also marks each skill as improved, newly verified or unchanged since the earlier assessment.
An assessment timeline records each completed assessment.
Your engineering leaders can check the current level of each skill and the date of its last assessment.
Keep assessments running as your teams change
A one-time skills survey covers the people who were on each team on the day of the survey.
In Skills Intelligence, an assessment program can run to an end date or stay open with no end date.
Administrators can add teams and assessments to an open program at any time.
An open program keeps assessing the teams you add to it without a new survey project.

Questions about employee skill tracking
An employee skill tracking platform is skills tracking software that keeps a current record of employees’ skills. Codility Skills Intelligence builds that record from scored tasks completed by knowledge workers across business functions and engineering.
Skills Intelligence tracks business roles and software engineering roles. General workforce tasks cover business roles that do not have a role-specific task. The Tech section covers software engineering areas including web, backend, mobile, data, cloud and DevOps. Engineering outside software is not covered, including hardware, firmware and mechanical engineering. Codility confirms that your roles map to available tasks before your first program.
No. Earlier assessments stay in the employee’s assessment timeline. For engineering skills, the current proficiency level updates to include each new assessment result.
Yes, for engineering skills. When an engineer completes a new assessment, the profile marks each assessed skill that improved since the earlier assessment. For business roles, each work simulation score stays in the employee’s record with its assessment date.
Yes. Your team can export skills data from Skills Intelligence through the Open API and add the tested results to your employee skills database. Skills Intelligence also integrates with the Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, BambooHR and Personio human resources information system (HRIS) platforms.
Employees see their own assessed skills in a personal profile. Engineers also receive AI-generated feedback on each completed coding task.
